highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure recovery and fixes a native shader-compiler lifetime issue.

bullets.detail: Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes, restores resolve dirty-state tracking, and includes the Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion workaround.
Fixes a native use-after-free in Raster Pipeline shader code generation.
Refreshes the bundled m150 engine without changing the managed API or native C API.
